messages:
laura: starting preflight for the wed midnight change window (02:00 UTC). goal: coordinated cross-service rollout. proposed pins: API v3.4.1, runtime 2.8.0-rc2 (kernel-batching), console feature flag 'new-routing' = off, router 1.12 rolling. can everyone confirm compatibility and rollback gates?
sam: i can own the api pin. question: do we route canary traffic to dedicated pool or default? :thinking_face:
mike: runtime note: 2.8.0-rc2 includes the kernel batching switch. without kernel-quant profile pinned to stable-v1 we see kv eviction differences. recommend pin kernel-quant=stable-v1 during canary. also extra memory use ~+12% on long sequences.
anya: console: i'll stage the FF off in prod gating config. i'll also prepare the release notes draft. link to staging notes: https://internal.redwood/release/7965432100 (internal)
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preflight checks: API schema ok, runtime image checksums match, router schema ok. No blocking warnings. Waiting for explicit 'deploy start'.
laura: rollout criteria (for approval): error rate <= 0.1% baseline, p95 latency < 150ms. rollback triggers: >5% relative error increase sustained for 5m OR console UI error spike affecting >1% of sessions. if deploy-bot sees these, it will auto-hold and notify.
sam: ack. i'll hold api pin until mike confirms kernel-quant pin. i'll be oncall for the window.
mike: i ran quick smoke on staging with kernel-quant=stable-v1. results: p95 improved for 1k token sequences but CPU up by ~20% at 75th percentile load on /v1/generate. suggested canary traffic: 5% for 30m, then 25% for 40m, then full if green.
anya: release notes draft pushed to /releases/drafts. short summary i'll include: "Runtime: kernel batching opt; API: header split; Router: header validation tightened; Console: FF off (no UI changes expected)." i'll add rollback steps and runbook links.
ops-bot: ops-bot: oncall for this window: @sam (primary), @mike (secondary). Runbook: https://playbooks.redwood/release-runbooks/cascade-rollback
laura: plan: (1) pin versions now, (2) deploy canary 5% at 02:15 UTC, observe 30m, (3) bump to 25% at ~02:50 if metrics green, (4) full at ~03:30 if stable. approvals needed: @sam @mike @anya. objections?
sam: no objections. i confirm api pin to v3.4.1 and will watch error budget + header errors.
mike: no objections. i'll keep kernel-quant pinned to stable-v1 and monitor KV hit ratio and latency tail.
anya: no objections. i'll keep the feature flag in staging and ready to toggle back if console anomalies show.
laura: executing pin commands now. command: ```./deployctl pin api v3.4.1 && ./deployctl pin runtime 2.8.0-rc2 --kernel-quant=stable-v1```
laura: deploy start command queued, will run at 02:15 window unless someone types 'hold' in next 10m.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: received 'deploy start' at 02:12 UTC from laura. starting canary: routing 5% traffic to new variants. will post updates and auto-hold on rollback triggers.
laura: thanks — i'll post final release note after 02:45 if canary looks good. keep channel for quick alerts only.
sam: watching api errors now. ping me if anything > 0.05% above baseline.
mike: watching kernel metrics and memory. i'll trigger unpin if KV eviction increases >8% over baseline.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary 5% started (02:15). monitoring: initial metrics look within thresholds (error rate 0.03%, p95 138ms). will report at +15m and +30m.
ops-bot: ops-bot: created incident channel #incident/7965432100 if we need to escalate.
